name: Ghost glyph headline card
looks: A flat colour card holds a short headline over one huge punctuation mark or glyph ghosted behind the type for scale, a small icon under the headline, and a thin dash rail along the bottom tracking position in a short sequence. The card hard-cuts to a near-identical one with new copy, same layout and rhythm.
build: The ghost glyph is one oversized character at 12-18% opacity, scaled 2-4x the headline's cap height, behind the text. Cards are hard cuts timed to the beat, with a small built-in lift on the headline (y: 6px -> 0, under 0.2s). The dash rail is n short rects, the active one wide/solid, past ones dim, future ones hollow.
sound: A dry tick on each card's arrival, nothing under the hold.
prompt: Hold a short, punchy headline on a flat colour card over one huge ghosted punctuation mark for scale, with a small icon under it and a thin dash rail tracking position in a short sequence. Hard-cut to a near-identical card with new copy, same layout and rhythm.
